_about: HIST-02: light IoU tracker vs ByteTrack port on the same YOLOv8n detections, before SIYAQ-BUG-001. Train+val clips only. crash_ok = predicted impact within 5 frames of the dataset's source crash frame; lc_ok = lane-change presence agrees with the unreviewed draft label. Test-split rows from the same run are deliberately not included here.

equivalence_with_official_bytetrack.tool: compare_official.py against ifzhang/ByteTrack (MIT), same detections, box difference <= 0.05 px
